// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28; contract RefundCallProbe { error Probe(bool success, bytes result, uint256 beforeGas, uint256 afterGas); constructor(address target, bytes memory payload, uint256 limit) payable { uint256 beforeGas = gasleft(); (bool ok, bytes memory result) = target.call{gas: limit}(payload); revert Probe(ok, result, beforeGas, gasleft()); } }
probe.method: payable constructor always reverts Probe outcome; zero endowment, finite outer Ethereum gas10,000,000,000,000,000 via read-only trace_call_versioned; read-only sender balance override100000tPOT for gas calibration; no persistent deployment or funding
